conservation.help_by: Give wildlife space; pick reef-safe sunscreen and careful finning.
conservation.caution_against: Don’t feed fish, chase animals, or pocket living souvenirs.

life_info.eating: Fish, crabs, scraps — opportunistic beach comedians. Pecks the wrack line; also follows boats for handouts.
life_info.mating: Nests in colonies on sandy islands.
life_info.habitat: Beaches, docks, and parking lots with a view of fries. Named for a laugh-like call that fills every pier.

fun_facts: That ‘ha-ha-ha’ call is why they’re never quiet vacation guests.
Summer black hoods molt to a winter smudge.
